{{Top|leg}}
The '''Prototype Heavy Laser''' was a [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] under development at [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Version 6 of the laser had a dangerously high and unstable energy draw, but it was eventually fixed and passed final testing for use in test ship models.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Starfighter]]'' {{1st}}
